subject: Weird "duplicate row.names" error when calling mqmscan()

messages.author: ac9a652c0abd9e37
messages.subject: Weird "duplicate row.names" error when calling mqmscan()
parts:
Hi Karl and others,

I'm confused by the following error message in mqmscan():

Error in `row.names<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, value = value) : 
  duplicate 'row.names' are not allowed
In addition: Warning message:
non-unique value when setting 'row.names': ‘24’

I'm able to read in my cross object fine, and the cross object runs normally in scanone(). I've now tried filling in genotypes with both mqmaugment() and fill.geno(), but neither works in mqmscan(). This is the final output of mqmscan(verbose=T), just before the error:

INFO: 0 Cofactors received to be analyzed
INFO: Number of locations per chromosome:  36 
INFO: Starting C-part of the MQM analysis
INFO: recombination parameters are not re-estimated
INFO: Re-estimation of the genetic map took 0 iterations, to reach a rdelta of 1.000000
INFO: Prob=0.020 Alfa=0.020000
INFO: Prob=0.019 Alfa=0.020000
INFO: dimX: 1, nInd: 253
INFO: F(Threshold, Degrees of freedom 1, Degrees of freedom 2) = Alfa
INFO: F(5.468, 1, 252) = 0.020000
INFO: F(4.003, 2, 252) = 0.020000
INFO: Log-likelihood of full model = -30664.849
INFO: Residual variance = 3.334
INFO: Trait mean= 0.102; Trait variation = 3.334
INFO: mapQTL function called
INFO: log-likelihood of full model = -30664.849554
INFO: Number of output datapoints: 756
INFO: All done in C returning to R
Error....

Just in case it was something screwy with augmented individuals, I tried using mqmaugment(cross, minprob=1.0), which shouldn't add pseudo individuals to the cross. I also tried saving the cross generated with mqmaugment(cross, minprob=.8), editing all the duplicate IDs so they are unique, and the running through mqmscan(). In both these cases, all row.names(cross$pheno) are unique.   No luck with either option...

I'm able to run simulated datasets through mqmscan, so there must be something screwy about my data. I've used the function many times in the past without trouble. I just can't figure out what might be throwing it off here, and am particularly confused given that there are no errors with the other scan functions.

Any help or ideas would be greatly appreciated,
Jesse

messages.author: 92292fc48bf46044
messages.subject: Re: Weird "duplicate row.names" error when calling mqmscan()
parts:
Hey Jesse,

Thanks for reporting this bug/error, I have a hunch that this has something to do with duplicate marker names (since it is
after the C part of the algorithm, where we construct the scanone output object), however I cannot be sure about that.

Are there pseudomarkers c1.loc10 in the input cross object ? if so, try deleting them and trying again.
If not (or if the error persists after removing the pseudomarkers), could you send me the dataset that is causing this error at Danny.Arends [at] Gmail.com, so that I can look into this error ??

Data will be treated confidential of course.

Gr,
Danny
